_oracle: Unity editor, HumanPoseHandler.SetHumanPose in batchmode (plan section 5)
_units: muscles and bodyPosition as HumanPose takes them: bodyPosition is in the Avatar's normalized units (divided by the human scale); local positions in metres, rotations as quaternions x, y, z, w, all in each transform's parent space; bones in GetComponentsInChildren order, root first

_tolerance.note: Absolute, per component. A quaternion matches its negation (q and -q are the same rotation). The recorded values themselves are Unity's float32 results, exact; the tolerance is the comparison bound.
